fullPassage: Capuchins ― New World Monkeys that live in large social groups ― will, in captivity, trade with people all day long, especially if food is involved. I give you this rock and you give me a treat to eat. If you put two monkeys in cages next to each other, and offer them both slices of cucumber for the rocks they already have, they will happily eat the cucumbers. If, however, you give one monkey grapes instead ― grapes being universally preferred to cucumbers ― the monkey that is still receiving cucumbers will begin to throw them back at the experimenter. Even though she is still getting "paid" the same amount for her effort of sourcing rocks, and so her particular situation has not changed, the comparison to another makes the situation unfair. Furthermore, she is now willing to abandon all gains ― the cucumbers themselves ― to communicate her displeasure to the experimenter.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② been → being: 'grapes being preferred'의 분사구문이므로 현재분사 being
det.analysis:
✅ ① live: 'New World Monkeys that live in large social groups'에서 선행사 Monkeys(복수)에 맞는 복수동사 — 적절
❌ ② been → being: 'grapes being universally preferred to cucumbers'는 분사구문으로, 포도가 선호되는 상태를 나타내는 현재분사 being이 필요. been(과거분사 단독)은 오류 ←정답
✅ ③ receiving: 'the monkey that is still receiving'에서 be + 현재분사 진행형 — 적절
✅ ④ willing: 'she is now willing to abandon'에서 be동사 보어 형용사 — 적절
det.tip: 분사구문: grapes being preferred(포도가 선호되면서). been(X)

questions.passage: ①If you put two monkeys in cages next to each other, and offer them both slices of cucumber for the rocks they already have, they will happily eat the cucumbers. ②If, however, you give one monkey grapes instead ― grapes being universally inferior to cucumbers ― the monkey that is still receiving cucumbers will begin to throw them back at the experimenter. ③Even though she is still getting "paid" the same amount for her effort of sourcing rocks, and so her particular situation has not changed, the comparison to another makes the situation unfair. ④Furthermore, she is now willing to abandon all gains ― the cucumbers themselves ― to communicate her displeasure to the experimenter.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 원문과 다르게 바뀐 부분을 포함하는 것은?

det.korean: ② inferior → preferred: 원문은 포도가 오이보다 '선호된다(preferred)'. inferior(열등한)는 항의 이유(포도가 더 좋음)와 모순
det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문 일치: 둘 다 오이면 기쁘게 먹는다
✅ ② inferior → preferred: 원문은 'grapes being universally preferred to cucumbers'(포도가 선호됨). inferior(열등한)로 바뀌면 포도가 오이보다 못하다는 뜻이 되어, 포도를 못 받아 항의한다는 내용과 모순 ←정답
❌ ③ 원문 일치: 같은 보수를 받지만 비교가 불공평을 만든다
❌ ④ 원문 일치: 불쾌감을 전달하려 오이마저 포기한다
det.tip: grapes preferred to cucumbers(선호) ↔ inferior(열등)는 항의 이유와 모순
